The '''Rescue on Kainnan''' was an event that occurred<ref name="Eruption" /> in [[25,793 BBY]]<ref name="ItV" /> on [[Zerist]], a moon of the gas giant [[Obri]]. [[Je'daii Ranger]] [[Hawk Ryo]] rescued [[Oma Dessain]], the daughter of mining magnate [[Eomin Dessain]], from a group of [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] kidnappers who were holding her in the evacuated workers' town of [[Kainnan]]. Ryo had discovered that a [[Shikaakwa|Shikaakwan]] ship registered to his brother, the crime lord Baron [[Volnos Ryo]], had been present on Zerist around the time of Oma's kidnapping, leading him to investigate the town.<ref name="Eruption" />

Ryo found two Twi'lek guards on the roof of a five-story building and killed them, using his [[sword]] and [[The Force]]. He then entered the building and discovered Oma bound and gagged in a workers' dormitory, where three more Twi'leks guarded her. Before Ryo could act, [[Sokar volcano]] located nearby erupted, providing a distraction. He used the chaos to kill the guard beside Oma with a Force-guided [[Knife/Legends|knife]] before attacking the other two guards. After killing them, Ryo freed Oma and carried her to the roof.
As volcanic ash and debris fell over Kainnan, Ryo attempted to contact Ranger [[Lanoree Brock]], but the ash interfered with his comm signal. Carrying Oma, he used the Force to leap between the rooftops and escape the town. During the rescue, Ryo drew upon the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] to enhance his aggression, but subsequently struggled to return himself to the balance taught by the Je'daii.<ref name="Eruption" />

==Behind the scenes==
This event appeared in [[Star Wars Insider 141|''Star Wars Insider'' 141]], in the story "[[Eruption]]" written by [[John Ostrander]] on [[April 30]], [[2013]]. The story featured the first appearance of Hawk Ryo alongside Lanoree Brock, and was set during the early years of the [[Dawn of the Jedi era]].<ref name="Eruption" />
